measurementSource.stabilityRule: same nonzero rect on two consecutive animation frames

frameClamp.formula: zFrame=max(viewportW/(2752+560+560),viewportH/(1536+200+0)); CSS px, DPR recorded but not used

repaintReference.sampling: every pixel in paintedReferenceWorldPx, compared against the approved 1x painting
repaintReference.colorSpace: CIELAB D65 deltaEab plus normalized sRGB

deepSeaVeil.source: PLAN-135 §10.11; shader uniform to be pinned before T5

classifier.swatchSelectionRule: 16px patch fully water in raw Mare alpha and homogeneous (patch P95 deltaE <= 8); radius = max(18, patchP95+6)

waterMask.encoding: PNG grayscale: 255=water, 0=non-water, derived as Mare alpha==255

waterMaskAfterOpening.encoding: PNG grayscale after cv2.MORPH_OPEN square 3x3 on raw water mask

samplingMask.encoding: PNG grayscale: 255=water, 0=non-water, derived as Mare alpha==255

metrics: photometric mean absolute sRGB per-channel, normalized 0..1
low-frequency mean absolute sRGB after blur sigma 32px, normalized 0..1
Sobel gradient continuity across join, 0..255 grayscale delta

coast-crossing.selectionRule: lattice positions whose 64px x 8px seam neighbourhood has 5%..95% land coverage in the raw Mare alpha mask

open-water.selectionRule: lattice positions whose seam neighbourhood has at most 2% land coverage in the raw Mare alpha mask

corner.selectionRule: lattice positions within 384px of a painted-canvas corner in both axes; internal corner proxy because apron corners do not exist in the source painting
